description: This file defines the CoinApiService interface which provides methods for accessing cryptocurrency market data through API calls, along with a data class for chart data.

classes.name: ChartData
classes.description: Holds information for chart data, including prices, market caps, and total volumes.

methods.name: getCoins
methods.description: Fetches a list of cryptocurrency coins with market data.

methods.name: getCoinChart
methods.description: Fetches the market chart data for a specific cryptocurrency identified by its ID.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Fetches the current prices for the specified cryptocurrency IDs.
